caveats_for_the_builder: This is the NATIONAL cross-industry file only. Per-occupation wage levels are here; if the design needs industry or state detail, a different OEWS archive is required.
ANNUAL and HOURLY are flag columns marking which occupations report annual-only or hourly-only wages; the GDPval wage-bill method depends on that distinction.
O_GROUP distinguishes major/minor/broad/detailed rows. Summing without filtering to detailed rows would double count.
OEWS is SOC-4/SOC-6 coded; O*NET is O*NET-SOC (8-digit). A crosswalk is required and is not part of this inventory.
